title: IncuBrix CreatorOps Platform Launch

copy.headline: Scale your creative workflow instantly
copy.support: Discover, generate, repurpose, and publish content seamlessly across all platforms.

concept: An elegant hub-and-orbit visual metaphor showcasing the unified CreatorOps pipeline, rendered in warm gold and deep navy tones to project premium innovation.

design_system.style: Modern minimalist vector illustration with smooth gradients, soft drop shadows, and glowing accent rings.
design_system.lighting: Top-left directional light casting subtle volumetric glows and soft radial depth.

composition.hero: A central glowing golden orb representing the unified platform, surrounded by four interconnected floating orbital nodes in rich navy and amber representing Discover, Generate, Repurpose, and Publish stages.
props: Floating golden sparkles around the core
Subtle connection arcs and data stream particles
Small geometric accent diamonds hovering near nodes
composition.background: Deep indigo to midnight blue vertical gradient with large, faint overlapping translucent golden circles.
decor: Soft ambient background glow behind the central hero
